title: Small language model: CPU decoder
result: Approximately 100 → 1950 tokens/s on one Ryzen 3700X core; full-span reference approximately 1540 tokens/s.
mechanism: Per-head attention windows, vectorised transcendentals, compact KV cache and packed integer GEMV.
limitation: Final span cap trades approximately +0.04 bits/byte for speed. Combined algorithm/cache/quantisation/ISA gain. Full-file decode time is a projection, not a completed run.
